title: Authorize user parameter maintenance with live user-parameter authority and bounded user and key validation
description: Stage 3 access-control closure for the per-user parameter rows that are read as user-level personalisation. src/ERP.Api/Controllers/UserParameterController.cs:13-16 declares UserParameterController with only [ApiController]/[Route(api/sys/user-parameters)]/[Authorize] and no identity, account-state or menu resolution: GetPaged 25-56 returns every nondeleted SysUserParameter (optionally filtered by an arbitrary UserId) together with the user display names, GetById 58-65 returns any row, Create 67-79 only checks the duplicate (UserId, ParamKey) at 71-72 and accepts any UserId without resolving it, Update 81-93 rewrites ParamKey/ParamValue and Delete 95-105 soft-deletes, so any authenticated account can read or rewrite another account's user parameters and can mint rows for arbitrary or nonexistent users. Reuse the existing 用户参数 (user-parameter, src/ERP.Infrastructure/Data/SeedData.Menus.cs:19) functional menu on every route, add bounded server-side validation for the persisted SysUserParameter columns (src/ERP.Domain/Entities/SysSystem.cs:35-47) and validate that UserId resolves to a known nondeleted user before any write, keeping the existing per-user duplicate-key check and the soft-delete semantics unchanged. No Domain/Infrastructure/schema change, no grant, no anonymous/admin fallback. Genuine isolated (localdb)\\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST SQL only; safe Release build plus full ERP.UnitTests. All entry points including in-process controllers must enforce live authorization. Adapt legacy fixtures by seeding an enabled identity and existing menu grants in the isolated test context; never gate authorization on Request.Path, environment, fake identity, or an empty request to bypass checks.
acceptance_criteria: For every route on /api/sys/user-parameters (paged, by-id, create, update and delete) require the current enabled nondeleted identity and the existing user-parameter functional menu before any read or write, rejecting missing, disabled, deleted and revoked-menu identities with the existing controlled non-disclosing errors and adding no new grants or anonymous/admin fallback.

Validate on create and update that ParamKey is non-empty and within its persisted length bound, that ParamValue stays within its persisted bound, and that UserId resolves to a known nondeleted user, so a rejected write persists no SysUserParameter row and the existing per-user duplicate-key check and soft-delete semantics stay unchanged.

Genuine isolated SQL authenticated controller tests cover the permitted privileged and menu-granted flows, missing user-parameter menu, disabled, deleted and revoked identities and invalid empty or over-long keys and values and unknown or deleted user ids, and assert that denied paged, by-id, create, update and delete calls read or mutate no SysUserParameter row while the existing SystemParameterAuthorizationTests and SysUserMasterAuthorizationTests contracts stay green.

Keep the safe Release build and the full existing ERP.UnitTests suite green, use only genuine isolated (localdb)\\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST databases with Integrated Security, and add no schema, entity, menu, permission or production/secret change; build completion is not stage acceptance.
implementation_evidence: src/ERP.Api/Controllers/UserParameterController.cs:13-16 declares UserParameterController with only [ApiController]/[Route(api/sys/user-parameters)]/[Authorize] and no Authorize/Menu/identity-resolution reference: GetPaged 25-56, GetById 58-65, Create 67-79 (only the duplicate (UserId,ParamKey) check at 71-72), Update 81-93 and Delete 95-105 query and write _db.SysUserParameters directly. SysUserParameter (src/ERP.Domain/Entities/SysSystem.cs:35-47) persists UserId(38), ParamKey(41-42, Required MaxLength 100) and ParamValue(45-46, MaxLength 500) with only attribute annotations, no foreign key and no UserId resolution. The re-used existing menu is seeded at src/ERP.Infrastructure/Data/SeedData.Menus.cs:19 and the frontend page is src/ERP.Api/wwwroot/js/user-params.js:30,80,96-97,105 registered at src/ERP.Api/wwwroot/js/app.js:376. The sibling closure precedent is src/ERP.Application/Services/SystemParameterAuthorizationRules.cs (ERP-446) with regression src/ERP.UnitTests/SystemParameterAuthorizationTests.cs, and the user-record closure is src/ERP.UnitTests/SysUserMasterAuthorizationTests.cs (ERP-453). There is no SysUserParameterAuthorizationRules in src/ERP.Application/Services and an exact search of .ai/tasks returns no task listing UserParameterController or SysUserParameter for live authorization.
